Group rides in Missouri

5 recurring group rides around Missouri: 3 road, 2 social, 1 gravel. 2 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with KC Critical Mass in Kansas City — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride runs beginner (up to 10 mi in 1:45), party pace 12–13 mph, intermediate 14–15 mph, advanced 16+ mph.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, every one of them for queer communities. You pledge a few cents a mile and vote where the money goes. It starts January 1.
